title: Cross-version RegisterStreams and vector pipeline binary surface comparison
question: Do per-layer registration-named functions persist from AE2025 to AE2026, and are their immediate callees type constructors or stream operation handlers?

hypotheses.prediction: Vector, text, base/AV layer have RegisterStreams routines in both versions.
hypotheses.falsified_by: Binary export inventory lacks equivalent signatures in either pinned DLL.

hypotheses.prediction: The vector RegisterStreams routine registers operations / commands, not necessarily stream types.
hypotheses.falsified_by: An independently verified factory registration dataflow demonstrates the routine only inserts native stream type descriptors.

procedure: Verify SHA-256 of both binaries and retain raw JSON output.
Compare bounded disassembly call targets to command-handling entrypoints without inferring an extensible type factory.
Host runtime tests and complete call/dataflow analysis remain separate experiments.
conclusion: E2-L static audit observed (layer-specific RegisterStreams plus command-related call targets). No dynamic host invocation or plug-in-native registration established.
limitations: Disassembly only; no complete control-flow or register lifetime analysis
A named RegisterStreams routine does not entail third-party registration support.
